(4) Small copy line directly above each button enlarged from ~8-10px to ~15-17px (clamp(15px,4vw,17px)), mobile only.
(5) Bottom countdown spacing made even and clean on mobile (gap from Social Feed card reduced ~86px to ~64px) so it clears the card glow without a dead gap or overlap.
(7) Removed the video-modal note: 'Pick a category first. Each category opens into its own video wall with breadcrumbs.'
